UAE Auto Solutions
Road Mechanic is a directory that helps car owners in the UAE find automotive workshops and the services they offer.

Road Mechanic lists automotive workshops across the seven emirates. Each listing shows the services offered, supported vehicle brands, working hours, location and contact details, so you can decide who to call before you drive anywhere.

A workshop registers through the website and submits its trade licence. Our team reviews the submission and either grants the verified badge or rejects it with a reason. Only workshops that passed this check show the verified badge. Trade licence documents are never published.

Customers can rate a workshop from one to five stars and leave a comment. Every review is moderated first. The score shown on a listing is the average of approved reviews only, and it is recalculated automatically whenever a review is approved or removed.
Listing is free. Register your company, add your photos, services and working hours, and submit it for verification.
Road Mechanic - UAE Auto Solutions
Contact details can be set in Website settings, section "Road Mechanic Directory".
To list a workshop, use the registration form. To update a listing you already own, sign in and open "My workshops".
